propositions: Extract binding identity transition rules (bind, confirm, unbind, numeric-ID re-key, reverse cleanup) from BindingStore into a new BindingLifecycle slice while preserving all existing behaviors exactly.
bind_confirm must remain last-writer-wins on the forward entry and pop exactly the one differing old reverse key with no sweep, ambiguity detection, or abort.
Stale reverse entries are removed only in four permitted cases: bind_confirm rebind, unbind with sweep, re-key operation, and _retire.
Numeric-ID re-key moves issues by swapping both indexes instead of retiring them, operating only when current key differs from stored key.

note_absent_or_rekey seam extracts only the re-key mutation logic (step 4) into BindingLifecycle.rekey and leaves the facade as coordinator for the guard, no-client/no-id fallthrough, and note_absent delegation.
Legacy records without numeric IDs must retain current behavior and facade signatures without being modified during read operations.
